reviews.comment: I'd recommend this course for someone who is interested in border issues. He doesn't hide his opinion but he also doesn't hold anything against people who disagree if they are respectful. We delved into the cultural, political, and law related aspects of border life. The reading isn't light, but it's manageable. Easy A if you do what's expected.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Let's just say if you have anything to say about his teaching besides his opinion, he'll grade you on in a bad way if you don't agree with him. There were a lot of people that spoke up against him(in a good way) and he immediately shut them down. He said that the people above him he didn't like (but why does he continue to be a teacher here). #no

Although not my favorite class, Dr Goldsmith was great. He truly cares about his students and loves what he teaches. This class is very discussion based, and as long as you truly study, go to class, and take notes you can pass all the tests. Extra credit is offered, so if you don't do well on the exams, you are still able to receive and A.
I loved this class and Professor Goldsmith! I learned so much and was really happy with the extra credit. Pay attention, show up, read the material and you will be just fine! Keep an open mind:)

I absolutely LOVED prof Goldsmith, he was so kind and helpful. If you show up to class and pay attention, you will do well in this class. He has an extra credit paper that can help boost your grade if needed! Would take again and again!!

Good professor, content was not always interesting. Had to complete 2 papers, 2 tests, and 1 final. He usually made us complete either a writing assignment or a pop quiz in class. Lots of reading you will have to do. Easy course if you put the effort in.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof Goldsmith is an amazing professor! Class is based on tests, essays, and pop quizzes. Tests cover everything said in lectures so coming to class is very important. He is very passionate about the US-Mexico Border and I have learned a lot from this class. I would 100% recommend this class to other people.

Really good at teaching, but he want you to be politically one-sided and there's a chance that it will reflect your grade if you are otherwise. Also, very good at persuading others to think on one side politically, which in reality you need to be able to have your own thoughts no matter what side you're on.

TAKE HIM! 
He is so amazing, his teachings are very passionate and interesting. By far one of my favorite classes because how much he cares about his students. I will say the articles are long but if you skim read for the discussions (optional) in class you'll be good. This class is definitely gonna have you write papers (3pg) or less tho. Easy A!

I absolutely loved this class! The discussions held were open, respectful, and really informative. Dr. Goldsmith is a great professor and absolutely hilarious. The classwork was not heavy or too much to handle, and the in-class discussions made everything clear and easy to understand. I would recommend this class to anyone!

One of the professors I've ever had at Texas A&M. I've never had a teacher label me a "Color-Blind-Racist" and flunk a well-written paper just because my opinion differed from his. If you have morals and are conservative, you will fail this class. The papers are straightforward if you write from a liberal standpoint. I do not recommend this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Goldsmith has been my favorite teacher throughout my college career. He's very knowledgeable and has a great way of making you see things from different perspectives. Great professor!

I didn't even buy the 3 books and easily got an A. He is really nice but he is VERY prejudice, rude and it is easy to get frustrated by the things he says in class. It seems like he finds it amusing also. He gives a lot of extra credit which is nice.
Dr. Goldsmith is an amazing prof. I took SOCI 203 with him and loved it. He is very passionate about the subject and knows his stuff. I loved going to this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Goldsmith was one of the most genuine professors I have had in college thus far. He is extremely passionate about the material he teaches, which makes this class interesting. This was one class I really enjoyed because he knows so much from not only textbooks but his personal experience. No complaints here. TAKE HIM.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Goldsmith is amazing! You have 3 papers you write and then the final(which is optional is you like your grade). You have to buy the books to be able to write the papers but you don't always have to read them.  He takes attendance so you have to go. Gives a good cushion with journal entries and outside events if you do bad on the essays.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Goldsmith is awesome! He is very passionate about what he teaches, and it shows. I could not have asked for a better prof for this class. He makes class very interesting and I really enjoyed it. If you pay attention in class, you will make an A or B.

He took mandatory attendance. You won't get any exams, rather you'll have a midterm and finals paper. As well as, I think 5-7 outside events that you'll have to go to, then writing a response about what you learn in those events. Papers weren't too hard, just take detailed notes. Not the easiest A, but definitely doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy journal entry every week. 3 out of class activities are required. two written tests (easy). Prof is over the top liberal, take with grain of salt. great class though. learned a lot. Easiest A in college. got a 100. He does take attendance though.
